## Trying response distributions out

```{r}
#| label: Model 1a: Simple_Poisson

# Abundance[i,year] ~ Poisson(λ[i,year])
# λ[i,year] ~ Uniform(0, 50)

sink("mod1a.txt")
cat("model {
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
    
    crab[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])
    
    lambda[i,year] ~ dunif(0,50)
    
    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # model-simulated data
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])

    # Pearson's residuals for both
    pr[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    pr.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    
    # square pr's
    pr2[i,year] <- pr[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- pr.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod1a.data <- list(ncell = nrow(crab),
                  nyear = ncol(crab),
                  crab = crab)

# Initial values
mod1a.inits <- function()list()

# Parameters monitored
mod1a.params <- c("lambda", "crab.new",
                 "bp") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod1a <- jags(mod1a.data, mod1a.inits, mod1a.params, "mod1a.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd()) 

print(out_mod1a, dig = 2) 
saveRDS(out_mod1a, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod1a.rds')

# notes:

# rhats: 1-1.01
# bp: 0.53 (0-1)
# pv: 12650.3
# dic: 25704.8
```

```{r}
#| label: Model 1b: Zero_Inflated

# original concept:
# Abundance[i,year] ~ Poisson(λ[i,year]) * ζ[i,year]
# λ[i,year] ~ Uniform(0, 50)
# ζ[i, year] ~ Bernoulli(Ψ)
# Ψ ~ Uniform(0, 1)

sink("mod1b.txt")
cat("model {

    #### universal prior ####
    
    psi ~ dunif(0,1)
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
    
    crab[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year] * z[i,year]) 
    
    z[i,year] ~ dbern(psi)
    
    lambda[i,year] ~ dunif(0,50)
    
    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # calculating the marginal variance
    mu[i,year]  <- psi * lambda[i,year]
    v[i,year] <- mu[i,year] + psi * (1 - psi) * lambda[i,year]^2

    # Pearson residual (ZIP-correct) 
    presid[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - mu[i,year]) / sqrt(v[i,year])
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year] * z[i,year])   
    presid.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - mu[i,year]) / sqrt(v[i,year])
    
    # square PR's
    pr2[i,year] <- presid[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- presid.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod1b.data <- list(ncell = nrow(crab),
                  nyear = ncol(crab),
                  crab = crab)

# Initial values
mod1b.inits <- function()list(z = matrix(1, ncol=ncol(crab),
                                         nrow=nrow(crab)))

# Parameters monitored
mod1b.params <- c("lambda", "z", "crab.new",
                 "bp") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod1b <- jags(mod1b.data, mod1b.inits, mod1b.params, "mod1b.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd())

print(out_mod1b, dig = 2)
saveRDS(out_mod1b, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod1b.rds')


# notes:

# rhats: 1 for lambdas, 1-1.13 for zs
# bp: 0.07 (0-1)
# pv: 184.2
# dic: 777.2

# questions for rem:
# i asked claude to check this for errors after i adjusted the ZI PRs and it suggested:
# 1. to calculate crab.new values using a z.new value calculated from its z.new ~ bernoulli(psi), rather than using the same z[i,year] because that creates a crab.new that's based on whether the cell was originally occupied
# 2. one point at [i,year] defines both z[i,year] and lambda[i,year] so lambda needs a more universal mu.lambda prior
# i haven't implemented either suggestion because they're both theoretically distinct from what we learned in class, but i could see both suggestions making sense. thoughts?
```

```{r}
#| label: Model 1bi: Zero_inflated_Poisson_wHyperparameters

# Claude edit:
# Abundance[i,year] ~ Poisson(λ[i,year]) * ζ[i,year]
# log(λ[i,year]) = mu.lambda + alpha[i] + beta[year]
# alpha[i] ~ Normal(0, tau.alpha)
# beta[year] ~ Normal(0, tau.beta)
# mu.lambda ~ Normal(0, 0.01)
# tau.alpha ~ Gamma(0.01, 0.01)
# tau.beta ~ Gamma(0.01, 0.01)
# ζ[i, year] ~ Bernoulli(Ψ)
# Ψ ~ Uniform(0, 1)

# also, changed from Model 1b because crab.new uses a new distribution for z

sink("mod1bi.txt")
cat("model {

    #### universal prior ####
    
    psi ~ dunif(0,1)
    tau.alpha ~ dgamma(0.01,0.01)
    tau.beta ~ dgamma(0.01,0.01)
    mu.lambda ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
    
    #### cell-level random effect ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
      alpha[i] ~ dnorm(0, tau.alpha)
    }
    
    #### year-level random effect ####
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
      beta[year] ~ dnorm(0, tau.beta)
    }
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
    
    crab[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year] * z[i,year]) 
    
    z[i,year] ~ dbern(psi)
    
    log(lambda[i,year]) <- mu.lambda + alpha[i] + beta[year]
    
    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # calculating the marginal variance
    mu[i,year]  <- psi * lambda[i,year]
    v[i,year] <- mu[i,year] + psi * (1 - psi) * lambda[i,year]^2

    # Pearson residual (ZIP-correct) 
    presid[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - mu[i,year]) / sqrt(v[i,year])
    z.new[i,year] ~ dbern(psi)
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year] * z.new[i,year])   
    presid.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - mu[i,year]) / sqrt(v[i,year])
    
    # square PR's
    pr2[i,year] <- presid[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- presid.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod1bi.data <- list(ncell = nrow(crab),
                  nyear = ncol(crab),
                  crab = crab)

# Initial values
mod1bi.inits <- function()list(z = matrix(1, ncol=ncol(crab),
                                         nrow=nrow(crab)))

# Parameters monitored
mod1bi.params <- c("lambda", "z", "crab.new", "psi",
                 "bp") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod1bi <- jags(mod1bi.data, mod1bi.inits, mod1bi.params, "mod1bi.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd())

print(out_mod1bi, dig = 2)
saveRDS(out_mod1bi, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod1bi.rds')

# notes:

# bp: 0.33
# rhats: 1 for bp, 1-1.3 for crab.news
# pv: 193.8
# dic: 1090.2
```

```{r}
#| label: Model 1c: Overdispersed_Poisson

# Abundance[i,year] ~ Poisson(λ[i,year])
# Log(λ[i,year]) = β0 + ε[i,year]
# β0 ~ Normal(0, 0.001)
# ε[i,year] ~ Normal(0, σ^2)
# σ ~ Uniform(0, 10)

sink("mod1c.txt")
cat("model {
    
    #### priors ####
    
    tau <- 1/sigma^2
    sigma ~ dunif(0,10)
    beta0 ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
    
    crab[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])
    
    log(lambda[i,year]) <- beta0 + e[i,year]
    
    e[i,year] ~ dnorm(0,tau)
    
    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # model-simulated data
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])

    # Pearson's residuals for both
    pr[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    pr.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    
    # square pr's
    pr2[i,year] <- pr[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- pr.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod1c.data <- list(ncell = nrow(crab),
                  nyear = ncol(crab),
                  crab = crab)

# Initial values
mod1c.inits <- function()list()

# Parameters monitored
mod1c.params <- c("lambda", "beta0", "e",
                  "crab.new", "bp") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod1c <- jags(mod1c.data, mod1c.inits, mod1c.params, "mod1c.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd())

print(out_mod1c, dig = 2)
saveRDS(out_mod1c, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod1c.rds')

# notes:

# bp: 0.36 (0-1)
# dic: 1278.8
# pv: 443.7
# rhats: 1.18 for beta0, 1-1.13 for es
```

#### Comparing overdispersion and zero-inflated distributions:

```{r}
#| label: calculating rhats for structural parameters

# code from Claude

# 1c; overdispersed
rhat_over <- out_mod1c$BUGSoutput$summary[, "Rhat"]
structural_params_over <- rhat_over[grepl("^(beta0|e\\[)", names(rhat_over))] # c("lambda", "beta0", "e", "crab.new", "bp") 
rhat_over_df <- data.frame(
  parameter = names(structural_params_over),
  Rhat = as.numeric(structural_params_over)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rhat))

# 1bi; zero-inflated
rhat_zip <- out_mod1bi$BUGSoutput$summary[, "Rhat"]
structural_params_zip <- rhat_zip[grepl("^(psi|z\\[)", names(rhat_zip))] # c("lambda", "z", "crab.new","bp")  
rhat_zip_df <- data.frame(
  parameter = names(structural_params_zip),
  Rhat = as.numeric(structural_params_zip)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rhat))

# R-hats both vary from 1 to 1.29 or 1.29
```

[Conclusion:]{.underline} both are very very similar. Technically, zero-inflated has slightly lower Rhats and DIC. I'm going to use the overdispersed model for simplicity, though. I feel more confident in my ability to write about that model and describe it, and AI had less of a role in generating the math, which I think leads to a lower likelihood of error. I may switch to zero-inflated in the future but it's not necessary right now.

## Linear model

```{r}
#| label: Model 2a: Overdispersed with all covariates and Gibbs selection

# Crab[i,year] ~ Poisson(lambda[i,year])
# log(lambda[i,year]) = b0 + 
# ... +
# eps[i,year]

sink("mod2a.txt")
cat("model {

    #### priors ####
    
    b0 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b1 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b2 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b3 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b4 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b5 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b6 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b7 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b8 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b9 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b10 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)
    b11 ~ dnorm(0,0.1)

    # overdispersed priors
    tau <- 1/sigma^2
    sigma ~ dunif(0,10)
    
    # indicator variable priors
    # indicator variable priors
    for (i in 1:11){
    w[i] ~ dbern(0.5)
    }
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(i in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:nyear){
    
    crab[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])
    
    log(lambda[i,year]) = b0 + 
    b1 * depth[i] * w[1] + 
    b2 * winter_mean[i,year] * w[2]  + b3 * winter_min[i,year] * w[3] + 
    b4 * summer_mean[i,year] * w[4] + b5 * summer_max[i,year] * w[5] +
    b6 * winter_flags[i,year] * w[6] + 
    b7 * spring_flags[i,year] * w[7] + b8 * yearly_flags[i,year] * w[8] +
    b9 * ddd[i,year] * w[9] + b10 * rdd[i,year] * w[10] +
    b11 * pop[i] * w[11] +
    eps[i,year]
    
    eps[i,year] ~ dnorm(0,tau)

    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # model-simulated data
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])

    # Pearson's residuals for both
    pr[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    pr.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    
    # square pr's
    pr2[i,year] <- pr[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- pr.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod2a.data <- list(ncell = nrow(matrices[["crab_abun"]]),
                  nyear = ncol(matrices[["crab_abun"]]),
                  depth = scale(matrices[["depth"]])[,1],
                  winter_mean = scale(matrices[["winter_mean"]])[,1:44],
                  winter_min = scale(matrices[["winter_min"]])[,1:44],
                  summer_mean = scale(matrices[["summer_mean"]])[,1:44],
                  summer_max = scale(matrices[["summer_max"]])[,1:44],
                  winter_flags = scale(matrices[["winter_flags"]])[,1:44],
                  spring_flags = scale(matrices[["spring_flags"]])[,1:44],
                  yearly_flags = scale(matrices[["yearly_flags"]])[,1:44],
                  ddd = scale(matrices[["ddd"]])[,1:44],
                  rdd = scale(matrices[["rdd"]])[,1:44],
                  pop = scale(matrices[["pop"]])[,1],
                  crab = matrices[["crab_abun"]])

# Initial values
mod2a.inits <- function()list()

# Parameters monitored
mod2a.params <- c("b0", "b1", "b2",
                  "b3", "b4", "b5",
                  "b6", "b7", "b8",
                  "b9", "b10", "b11",
                  "bp", "eps", "w") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod2a <- jags(mod2a.data, mod2a.inits, mod2a.params, "mod2a.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd()) # took maybe half an hour

saveRDS(out_mod2a, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod2a.rds')

print(out_mod2a, dig = 2)

# notes:

# pv: 529.4
# dic: 1353.7
# rhats: 1-1.03 for eps, 1-1.3 for betas and 2.25 for beta0
# bp: 0.29 (0-1) n.eff 250
# see betas and omegas below

# key to the betas and omegas:
# 1 = depth
# 2 = winter_mean; 3 = winter_min
# 4 = summer_mean; 5 = summer_max
# 6 = winter_flags; 7 = spring_flags
# 8 = yearly_flags
# 9 = ddd; 10 = rdd;
# 11 = pop
```

```{r}
    #### derived parameters ####
    
    # model-simulated data
    crab.new[i,year] ~ dpois(lambda[i,year])

    # Pearson's residuals for both
    pr[i,year] <- (crab[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    pr.new[i,year] <- (crab.new[i,year] - lambda[i,year])/sqrt(lambda[i,year])
    
    # square pr's
    pr2[i,year] <- pr[i,year]^2
    pr2.new[i,year] <- pr.new[i,year]^2
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # i loop
    
    # sum pr's
    d.pr <- sum(pr2)
    d.pr.new <- sum(pr2.new)
    
    # Bayesian p-value
    bp <- step(d.pr - d.pr.new)
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod2c.data <- list(ncell = nrow(matrices[["crab_abun"]]),
                  nyear = ncol(matrices[["crab_abun"]]),
                  depth = scale(matrices[["depth"]])[,1],
                  winter_mean = scale(matrices[["winter_mean"]])[,1:44],
                  pop = scale(matrices[["pop"]])[,1],
                  crab = matrices[["crab_abun"]])

# Initial values
mod2c.inits <- function()list()

# Parameters monitored
mod2c.params <- c("b0", "b1", "b2",
                  "b3", "bp", "eps") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 10000; nb <- 1000

# run the model
out_mod2c <- jags(mod2c.data, mod2c.inits, mod2c.params, "mod2c.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd()) # took maybe five minutes

saveRDS(out_mod2c, '/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Models/Out/out_mod2c.rds')

print(out_mod2c, dig = 2)

# notes:

# pv: 5485.4
# dic: 1313.8
# rhats: much better, still 2 for b0
# bp: 0.31
# see betas below

rows <- rownames(out_mod2c$BUGSoutput$summary)
print(round(out_mod2c$BUGSoutput$summary[rows, ], 2))
```

-   Summer_mean and winter_mean are collinear so winter_mean effect was getting muddled; makes interpretation less clear

## N-Mixture Model

```{r}
#| label: Model 3a: N-Mixture Model with no covariates

# Crab[cell, year, season] ~ dbinom(p,N[cell, year])
# N[cell, year] ~ dpois(lambda)

# Note from when I was originally writing this for 913 final: went in a bit of a circle with chat trying to get a good bp here - i started with a global residual/bp calculation which yielded a bp of zero. chat suggested i specify bp to each cell/year/season, but when that yielded a lot of 1s it told me that was fine and i was overspecifying and should try a global bp. the conclusion seems to be that a poor bp is fine for this iteration since i don't have any parameters on p yet and some of my individual cell/year/season indices' bps aren't one

crab <- matrices[["monthly_crab_abun"]]
rm(matrices)

sink("mod3a.txt")
cat("model {

    #### priors ####
    
    lambda ~ dunif(0,10)
    p ~ dunif(0,1)
    
    #### likelihood ####
    
    for(cell in 1:ncell){
    
    for(year in 1:ncol){
    
    N[cell,year]  ~ dpois(lambda)

    for(month in 1:12){

    crab_seas[cell, year, month] ~ dbinom(p,N[cell,year]) # observed data
    
    crab_draw[cell, year, month] ~ dbinom(p,N[cell,year]) # random data drawn from the model
    
    crab_pred[cell, year, month] <- N[cell,year] * p # prediction
    
    # freeman-tukey residuals
    
    tukey[cell,year,month] <- pow(sqrt(crab_seas[cell,year,month]) - sqrt(crab_pred[cell,year,month]), 2)
    tukey_draw[cell,year,month] <- pow(sqrt(crab_draw[cell,year,month]) - sqrt(crab_pred[cell,year,month]), 2)
    
    } # month loop
    
    } # year loop
    
    } # cell loop
    
    # total crabs
    total.crabs.everywhere <- sum(N[,])
    for(year in 1:ncol){total.crabs.year[year] <- sum(N[,year])}
    
    # seasonal tukey residual bp
    tukey_sum <- sum(tukey[,,])
    tukey_draw_sum <- sum(tukey_draw[,,])
    bp_indiv <- step(tukey_draw - tukey) # a lot of these are one but chat says that's ok
    
    } # end of model  
",fill = TRUE)
sink()

# data
mod3a.data <- list(ncell = dim(crab)[1],
                  ncol = dim(crab)[2],
                  crab_seas = crab)

# Initial values
mod3a.inits <- function(){
  crab_sum <- apply(crab, c(1,2), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  list(N = crab_sum + 1)
}

# Parameters monitored
mod3a.params <- c("N","p","lambda",
                  "total.crabs.everywhere","total.crabs.year",
                  "bp_indiv") 

# MCMC settings
nc <- 3; nt <- 1; ni <- 1000; nb <- 100

# run the model
out_mod3a <- jags(mod3a.data, mod3a.inits, mod3a.params, "mod3a.txt", 
                 n.chains = nc, n.thin = nt, n.iter = ni, n.burnin = nb, 
                 working.directory = getwd())
options(max.print=200000)
print(out_mod3a, dig = 2)

# code to get specific output from Claude
rows <- grep("^p$|^lambda$|^total.crabs.everywhere$|^total.crabs.year", 
             rownames(out_mod3a$BUGSoutput$summary))
print(round(out_mod3a$BUGSoutput$summary[rows, ], 2))

# notes:

# doesn't run for 10000 iterations
# bp.indivs very bad, all 1 with n.eff 1
# dic 4666.5
# pv 1161.8
# rhats are good for p, lambda, total.crabs.everywhere
```

```{r}
#| label: response curves for 2b

post2c <- as.matrix(out_mod2c$BUGSoutput$sims.matrix) 
colnames(post2c)

# covariate sequences
depth_seq <- seq(min(scale(matrices[["depth"]])[,1]), 
                 max(scale(matrices[["depth"]])[,1]), 
                 length.out = 1000); depth_mean <- mean(depth_seq)
winter_seq <- seq(min(scale(matrices[["winter_mean"]])[,1]), 
                  max(scale(matrices[["winter_mean"]])), 
                  length.out = 1000); winter_mean <- mean(winter_seq)
pop_seq <- seq(min(scale(matrices[["pop"]])[,1]), 
                  max(scale(matrices[["pop"]])[,1]), 
               length.out = 1000); pop_mean <- mean(pop_seq)

# estimate response to depth
depth_scaled <- outer(post2c[, "b0"], rep(1, 1000)) +
        outer(post2c[, "b1"], depth_seq) + 
        outer(post2c[, "b2"], rep(1, 1000)) * winter_mean +
        outer(post2c[, "b3"], rep(1, 1000)) * pop_mean
depth_mu <- exp(depth_scaled)
# dataframe with uncertainty
depth_df <- data.frame(
  x = depth_seq,
  x_scale = depth_seq * attr(scale(matrices[["depth"]]), 'scaled:scale') +
                               attr(scale(matrices[["depth"]]), 'scaled:center'),
  q2.5 = apply(depth_mu, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  q50  = apply(depth_mu, 2, quantile, 0.5),
  q97.5= apply(depth_mu, 2, quantile, 0.975),
  var = "Depth")

# estimate response to winter
winter_scaled <- outer(post2c[, "b0"], rep(1, 1000)) +
        outer(post2c[, "b1"], rep(1,1000)) * depth_mean + 
        outer(post2c[, "b2"], winter_seq) +
        outer(post2c[, "b3"], rep(1, 1000)) * pop_mean
winter_mu <- exp(winter_scaled)
# dataframe with uncertainty
winter_df <- data.frame(
  x = winter_seq,
  x_scale = winter_seq * attr(scale(matrices[["pop"]]), 'scaled:scale') + 
    attr(scale(matrices[["pop"]]), 'scaled:center'),
  q2.5 = apply(winter_mu, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  q50  = apply(winter_mu, 2, quantile, 0.5),
  q97.5= apply(winter_mu, 2, quantile, 0.975),
  var = "Mean winter temperature")

# estimate response to pop
pop_scaled <- outer(post2c[, "b0"], rep(1, 1000)) +
        outer(post2c[, "b1"], rep(1, 1000)) * depth_mean + 
        outer(post2c[, "b2"], rep(1, 1000)) * winter_mean +
        outer(post2c[, "b3"], pop_seq)
pop_mu <- exp(pop_scaled)
# dataframe with uncertainty
pop_df <- data.frame(
  x = pop_seq,
  x_scale = attr(scale(matrices[["pop"]]), 'scaled:scale') + 
    attr(scale(matrices[["pop"]]), 'scaled:center'),
  q2.5 = apply(pop_mu, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  q50  = apply(pop_mu, 2, quantile, 0.5),
  q97.5 = apply(pop_mu, 2, quantile, 0.975),
  var = "Human population")
  
toplot2b <- rbind(depth_df, winter_df, pop_df)

responses <- ggplot(toplot2b, aes(x = x, y = q50)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q2.5, ymax = q97.5, fill = var), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(size = 1, aes(color = var)) +
  facet_wrap(~var, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d("Covariate", option="D") +
  scale_color_viridis_d("Covariate", option="D") +
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = toplot2b$x, labels = toplot2b$x_scale) +
  labs(x = "Covariate value (centered and scaled)",
       y = "Predicted crab abundance") + # this is predicted crabs per ~550km per year
  theme_classic()

ggsave(plot=responses, "/Users/kailafrazer/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-USNH/Crab/Figs/GRS/Response_Curves.png", width = 8, height = 3)
```
